params.name: namespace
params.description: Restrict the index to a single namespace, e.g. wp/v2.

items.docs: Returns the site discovery document: name, description, URL, registered namespaces, the full route table (270 routes across 20 namespaces on this site) and the supported authentication methods. This is the WordPress REST API's own machine-readable index and is the only contract Allotex publishes.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to.

params.name: _embed
params.description: Embed linked resources (author, featured media, terms) into the response.

items.docs: Cross-content search returning lightweight {id, title, url, type, subtype} records. Verified 2026-08-06 with search=cornea, which returns the Medical Advisory Board, Science and Conditions We Treat pages. 21 searchable items total.

info.name: Get an oEmbed response for a site URL

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the resource for which to fetch oEmbed data.

items.docs: oEmbed 1.0 provider endpoint. Returns provider_name 'Allotex US', the author, the title, a thumbnail and an iframe embed for any URL on this site. Verified against https://us.allotex.com/procedure/.

info.name: Get the MCP namespace route index

items.docs: Returns the routes registered under the 'mcp' namespace. Verified 2026-08-06: 200, advertising /mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server (GET/POST/DELETE). This is the WordPress MCP Adapter's default server. It is DISCOVERABLE anonymously but NOT USABLE: a JSON-RPC tools/list POST to the server endpoint returns 401 rest_forbidden. Allotex does not document, market or issue credentials for this endpoint, so no MCP agent surface is claimed for this provider. See mcp/allotex-mcp.yml.
